Here’s a six‑line poem on the theme of “first light”:

Morning slips through curtains thin,  
A gold‑tipped brush on sleepy walls.  
Birdsong stitches quiet air,  
While dew‑kissed grass begins to gleam.  
Day awakens, soft and bright—  
Hope reborn in sunrise’s sigh.
